text: Plan targets **CIKM 2027** (8 months: annotation set, baselines, writing); **WWW 2027 abandoned** (Oct 18 deadline, 5 weeks insufficient). Alternatives: **SIGIR 2027 AP Track**, **KBS journal** (IF≈8.8), **TKDE**. CIKM desk-reject traps: abstract deadline one week early freezing author list, appendix counts toward 10-page limit, mandatory GenAI Usage Disclosure, unfilled EasyChair reviewer nomination. Tier-1 rivals: **CRAG**, **Self-RAG**, **MCP-Pyserini** (first MCP-based RAG). Proposed title: "Content-Verified Retrieval with Experience-Grounded Credibility for Agentic Knowledge Bases." Benchmark sets A–E: A = 30 docs/11 domains; C (core) = 40+ queries (expand to 100), reporting P@5, R@5, nDCG@5, FPR; D = 15+ Q&A; E = 10 tasks. Annotation needs 3 annotators, **Cohen's κ ≥ 0.7**, frozen public artifact.
